# advanexus

> Existing systems. Less manual work between them.

advanexus connects data preparation and transfer, business checks and analysis. Get a result that can be explained, reused and taken into the next step, without replacing your existing systems.

Preparation, checks, analysis and follow-up often sit in separate tools. advanexus connects these steps around the same result, with its definitions, versions and available execution records. Existing systems keep their roles; teams get a reusable way to work across them.

## Brand meaning

Progress that stays connected. advanexus brings advance and nexus together: moving forward without breaking the connection between data, decisions, accountability and evidence.

## Business problems

- [Why does the report not reconcile?](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/regulatory-reporting/): Compare the prepared report with operational records and the general ledger. Identify the items behind a difference instead of rebuilding the comparison by hand.
- [What happened to this payment?](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): Connect channel, processing, ledger and settlement records. See which stages are confirmed and where a record or explanation is still missing.
- [What prevents this delivery from closing?](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/logistics-supply-chain/): Bring together transport, warehouse and receipt records. Identify the missing step or document holding up the next action.
- [Was this request really abandoned?](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): Compare application, branch and request records. Separate completed, cancelled, open and unresolved journeys before drawing a conclusion.
- [Who qualifies for this benefit?](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/governed-analytics-delivery/): Connect membership, previous benefit use and contact rules. Separate candidates, exclusions and cases needing review, with a reason for each.
- [Which exception needs attention?](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/audit-ready-data-operations/): Compare the recorded event with the applicable rule and approval. Distinguish explained differences from exceptions still requiring investigation.
- [The file arrived. Is it ready to use?](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/data-modernization/): Check partner data against the expected structure and quality rules. Prepare usable data for analysis or transfer, and identify what needs correction.
- [The transfer finished. Was it correct?](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/controlled-data-migration/): Compare source and destination against the agreed mapping. Review record and value differences before accepting the transferred data.

## Core use cases

- AI Migration Assurance: An accepted source-to-target path connects the known baseline, supported mappings and transformations, persisted execution, business checks, unresolved exceptions, accountable decision and available evidence. Business outcome: A migration rehearsal or cutover whose accepted result, exceptions and recovery readiness are visible in one review path.
- Recurring reporting from multiple sources: CSV, XLSX, JSON and delimited exports become managed tables; one authorised SQL join turns them into a versioned dataset and report, while discussion and review context stay with the exact result. Business outcome: A shorter path from data cut-off to an accepted report and fewer manual hand-offs.
- Quality before business delivery: Required fields, unique keys, expected row counts, ranges, allowed values, parent relationships or a specific business rule can stop the flow before acceptance or remain visible as a warning. Business outcome: Earlier detection, fewer reissues and less time to a correct result.
- Analytics and AI assistance with a human decision: A versioned input is reused in reporting or controlled Python analysis; AI assistance finds only permitted context and prepares an explanation or suggestion, a person confirms the action, and commentary remains with the object. Business outcome: A repeatable insight with less context search and a clear distinction between an AI suggestion and an executed action.
- Recovery confirmed with business data: Copy, controlled deletion, waiting, restoration and the final business check become one visible procedure. Business outcome: Less downtime and a decision to reopen based on validated data, not only a green technical status.
- Audit, regulatory request or investigation: From the question, Assurance Center leads to the relevant result or execution, its linked version, check, owner and outcome, and then to a review or bounded evidence package. Business outcome: A faster first trusted answer with fewer rounds of follow-up and a known evidence boundary.

## Connected outcome paths

- Start with the result the organisation needs—not a module name.
- Each path below connects the business need to an accepted input, controlled action, accountable owner and evidence that can be reviewed later.
- [Move and reconcile information](https://www.advanexus.com/product/data-operations/): Move supported data between existing systems, apply explicit checks and retain the result needed to accept or investigate the transfer.
- [Stop avoidable errors before delivery](https://www.advanexus.com/product/data-quality/): Put agreed checks in the operating path so a critical error can block acceptance and a warning remains attached to the exact execution.
- [Produce a result people can repeat](https://www.advanexus.com/product/controlled-analytics/): Bind a report, dashboard or analysis to an accepted data contract and keep the exact version and execution context behind the delivered result.
- [Investigate without rebuilding the story](https://www.advanexus.com/product/assurance/): Move from an outcome or exception to the permitted versions, runs, owners, findings and supporting records behind it.
- [Extend analysis without losing context](https://www.advanexus.com/product/anpy/): Continue in Python when deeper work is needed while preserving the project, input, environment, execution and bounded result.
- [Let AI accelerate work without taking authority](https://www.advanexus.com/product/intelligence/): Intelligence can explain or propose within the current user's scope; deterministic services, policy and people remain responsible for state-changing action.

## Best fit and value unit

- Capacity defines licensed product use. It is not a commitment to build every connection or business flow.
- Tenant: One isolated organisational and data boundary within the agreed software scope.
- Registered system connection: One configured source or target connection. Building and adapting the integration is separate.
- Controlled business process or flow: One agreed flow counted within licensed use. Designing and implementing it is a separate service.
- Top-level controlled execution: One root execution within the licensed annual volume. Child attempts and retries are not separate public value units.
- Production or non-production environment: One licensed production or non-production environment. Cloud and infrastructure operation are excluded.
- Evidence and retention profile: A contracted retention profile for named object classes. It does not promise retention automation, legal hold or signing; storage consumption is separate.

## Category and differentiation

- advanexus is not trying to be the deepest warehouse, orchestrator, catalogue, observability product, BI suite or AI model.
- Its value is the shared control and evidence path when one business outcome crosses several of them.
- Choose advanexus when speed across systems must not break control, accountability or proof.
- Broad enterprise platforms can replace or consolidate more of the stack; deep specialists can be stronger in one layer. advanexus is the focused choice when the organisation wants to keep capable systems, control a critical cross-system process or migration and preserve one evidence chain from context and authority to outcome and recovery. The advantage is continuity across boundaries—not a claim to be deepest in every specialist category.
- Systems of record and operational applications: A connected control record when execution moves between systems.
- Data, integration and orchestration platforms: Business acceptance, exact versions, responsibility and evidence across the path.
- Governance, catalogue, GRC and service tools: Runtime-linked evidence showing what actually executed and happened.
- Observability and data-quality specialists: Control before acceptance and an accountable business response after detection.
- AI platforms and internal agents: Permitted context, deterministic validation, human authority and canonical outcome.

## Decision guidance

- A migration must be accepted, not merely declared complete: It connects the accepted baseline, supported mappings, persisted execution, reconciliation, exceptions, cutover or recovery decision and available evidence around the move.
- A recurring figure or report from several sources: It turns different inputs into reusable tables, retains dataset and report versions and binds discussion and review context to the exact result.
- An error must be found before delivery: A critical business check can stop the same supported flow, while the reason, owner and corrective discussion remain with that execution.
- Recovery must confirm that the business can operate again: It does not replace backup; it connects a verified copy, restoration, business comparison and the decision to reopen in one visible procedure.
- Audit or an incident needs a fast, supported answer: Assurance Center leads from the question to the relevant result or execution, its version, check, owner and a review package in a known scope.
- AI should accelerate work without becoming the authority: Registered AI assistance uses permitted context, separates proposal from deterministic execution and keeps policy, human authority, canonical result and commentary with the object.

## Product questions and boundaries

- What is advanexus? advanexus is the control and evidence system for critical enterprise execution across supported systems, data flows, automation and registered AI-assisted actions. It connects context, rules, authority, execution, outcome, recovery and available evidence in one scoped operating model.
- What business problem does advanexus solve? It solves the control gap that appears when one important result crosses several platforms and teams. Instead of reconstructing which data, version, rule, approval and action produced the outcome, advanexus keeps those supported references connected while work happens.
- Who buys advanexus? It is relevant to leaders accountable for critical data and operational outcomes: CIO and COO organisations, data and platform leaders, finance and analytics owners, risk and compliance, audit, resilience, transformation and controlled AI programmes. A bounded pilot begins with one process they already need to accept or explain.
- Does advanexus replace systems of record, a warehouse, orchestrator, BI tool or notebook? No. Authoritative transactions, storage, compute and specialist work remain in the systems that already perform them. advanexus adds a shared control and evidence path across supported hand-offs and also provides controlled modules where that path is needed.
- How does advanexus control AI-assisted actions? A model may explain permitted context or propose a registered action. Deterministic services validate, policy and people authorise state-changing work, and the canonical service records what actually happened. advanexus is not an unrestricted autonomous agent or a second authorisation system.
- What is AI Migration Assurance? It is a controlled use case around an accepted migration path: establish the baseline, retain mappings and known exceptions, execute through supported connectors, reconcile the business result, record approval or recovery decisions and preserve available evidence for review.
- Can advanexus migrate any SaaS, ERP, cloud or AI provider automatically? No universal one-click migration is claimed. Source and target support, semantic and permission mapping, transformation, reconciliation, cutover and recovery depend on the exact connector, data, workflow and accepted deployment. advanexus makes supported scope and gaps explicit.
- What evidence does advanexus preserve? Depending on the supported module, the system can connect actors, versions, runs, quality decisions, outcomes, artifacts, findings, cases and checksum-verifiable Evidence Packages. Source strength and missing evidence remain visible; a package is not automatically a digital signature, WORM record or legal conclusion.
- Can a result be reproduced and explained later? advanexus preserves exact contracts and execution context where the capability supports them, then assesses explicit reproducibility criteria. It reports reproducible, partially reproducible, not reproducible or not assessed rather than promising universal replay.
- Do all connectors support the same operations? No. Source, driver and deployment contracts decide metadata, preview, query, transfer, write, quality and analytics behaviour for the exact connector environment.
- Where does customer data live? Deployment and job policy decide the path. Supported STANDARD work may use controlled spool, EPHEMERAL_STAGING requires verified deletion before success, and NO_STAGING permits only a content-free source-to-target path with bounded in-memory pages. Connector and production acceptance still apply.
- Does advanexus guarantee regulatory compliance? No. The product can support controlled execution, human oversight, traceability, investigation and evidence obligations. Applicability, legal interpretation, retention, signing, certification and regulator acceptance remain specific to the organisation and implemented control environment.
- Does a deployment become production-ready automatically? No. Production sign-off requires the exact revision, immutable images, target infrastructure and recorded migration, authorisation, recovery, storage, connector and operational acceptance.
- How does pricing work? All platform modules, including Intelligence. Capacity and environments according to the agreed profile. Product support according to the agreed profile. Excludes VAT. Outside the licence: Cloud, infrastructure preparation and operation, implementation, custom development, integrator services and external provider consumption.
- How should an organisation start? Choose one process, migration, report, recovery or AI-assisted action whose result matters. Define its systems, owners, rules, approvals, failure path, evidence obligation and pilot measures before discussing a broad rollout. Existing users can continue through Open demo.

- AWS: Support for platform development and the establishment of scalable infrastructure.
- Mainstream: Expertise in the design, implementation and technical verification of AWS infrastructure.

## Industry contexts

### [Bring readings and billing into agreement.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/energy/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/energy/#section-1-title): Compare readings, periods and billed quantities using agreed rules and identify exceptions for review.
  - [Meter extracts contain missing intervals or readings.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/trusted-bi-ai-inputs/): Compare meter identifiers, time intervals and units. Find missing readings and inconsistent coverage before preparing the calculation.
  - [Contract periods and billed quantities do not align.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): Connect contract dates, readings and billed quantities. Review differences for the same period and unit.
  - [Two forecasts use different input versions.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/governed-analytics-delivery/): Compare the saved input versions, periods and assumptions used by each forecast. Establish what changed before interpreting the result.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/energy/#section-2-title): Give operations and finance a shared basis for checking differences.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/energy/#section-3-title): Compare one agreed billing period or reporting sample. Measure missing intervals, differences and preparation time. Metering and billing rules remain your responsibility.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/energy/#section-4-title): Reuse the same period, unit and completeness checks for the next billing cycle. Retain the chosen input and result versions for an explainable comparison.

### [Know why the numbers do not match.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/financial-services/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/financial-services/#section-1-title): Connect reporting inputs, check differences and trace a figure back to its source and the report version used.
  - [Payments recorded. Settlement still needs reconciling.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): Compare the payment, ledger entry and settlement reference. See which stages agree and which still need confirmation.
  - [The report depends on last-minute corrections.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/regulatory-reporting/): Compare the prepared report with control data and the general ledger. Review the individual records behind each difference.
  - [Different teams submit different figures for the same period.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/governed-analytics-delivery/): Check the reporting period, filters and data version together. Distinguish changed inputs from a changed calculation.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/financial-services/#section-2-title): A shared basis for reviewing exceptions and explaining a reported number.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/financial-services/#section-3-title): Compare one settlement or reporting cycle. Measure review time, unresolved differences and repeat submissions. Financial decisions stay with your team.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/financial-services/#section-4-title): Reuse the agreed source connections and checks for the next reporting period. Preserve each selected result version so finance can explain what changed without rebuilding the preparation.

### [See the whole claim, not separate fragments.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/insurance/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/insurance/#section-1-title): Bring the data together, check missing links and compare claims and payments using agreed definitions.
  - [A claim waits for missing policy or payment data.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): Link the claim to its policy, coverage period and payment records. Identify missing references before the next review.
  - [Partner statements and commissions do not match.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): Compare partner references, commission calculations and recorded payments. Separate unmatched entries from amount differences.
  - [A review needs the exact inputs behind a previous result.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/audit-ready-data-operations/): Open the saved input and report versions with the available execution records. Review the basis of the earlier result.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/insurance/#section-2-title): A clearer view of which records need attention and what needs checking next.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/insurance/#section-3-title): Check one authorised claim or settlement sample. Measure missing references, follow-up requests and preparation time. Coverage decisions remain with qualified staff.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/insurance/#section-4-title): Reuse the agreed links and checks for the next claims or settlement batch. Keep the result version and unresolved cases available to the people responsible for review.

### [Find what is holding up a delivery.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/logistics-supply-chain/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/logistics-supply-chain/#section-1-title): Connect the shipment information and highlight delays, missing documents and differences between recorded statuses.
  - [A shipment has different statuses across systems.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): Follow the same shipment reference through transport and warehouse records. See where the recorded statuses stop agreeing.
  - [Delivery is recorded, but confirmation is missing.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/audit-ready-data-operations/): Compare deliveries with their receipt confirmations. Identify the shipments that still lack the required document.
  - [An invoice and its recorded payments need comparing.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): Connect the shipment, invoice and payment references. Review missing records and amount differences without reassembling separate extracts.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/logistics-supply-chain/#section-2-title): One view for deciding what to investigate, without guessing the cause of a delay.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/logistics-supply-chain/#section-3-title): Check one shipment across available sources. Measure missing confirmations and investigation time. A status does not prove the cause of a delay.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/logistics-supply-chain/#section-4-title): Repeat the shipment review with new operational records. Reuse the preparation and checks, while keeping missing confirmations and the result of each execution visible.

### [Bring departmental information into one review.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/public-sector/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/public-sector/#section-1-title): Combine authorised data, check completeness and keep the source and version behind each result visible.
  - [A digital request still requires manual data collection.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): Connect the request, departmental records and required attachments. Separate complete cases from those awaiting information.
  - [Departments use different versions of the same extract.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/governed-analytics-delivery/): Compare the period, extract version and included records. Make disagreements visible before combining departmental totals.
  - [A completed migration still awaits business acceptance.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/controlled-data-migration/): Compare agreed identifiers, counts and values before accepting a move. Keep unresolved differences available for review.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/public-sector/#section-2-title): A repeatable review process with clear access and traceable reporting inputs.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/public-sector/#section-3-title): Review one authorised exchange or migration sample. Measure missing fields, repeated submissions and acceptance time. Legal authority must be established separately.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/public-sector/#section-4-title): Reuse the agreed submission structure and checks across reporting periods. Keep source versions and unresolved cases connected to the submitted result.

### [Follow the order through to the bill.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/telecommunications/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/telecommunications/#section-1-title): Connect order, activation and billing records to find differences and the information needed to resolve them.
  - [An order exists, but activation is not confirmed.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): Link the order and contract to the activation record. Find orders with no confirmed completion.
  - [Activation and billing show different service states.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): Compare activation dates, service periods and billing records. Identify entries that need an operational or financial review.
  - [An upstream format change disrupts a downstream report.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/trusted-bi-ai-inputs/): Check incoming columns and required fields against the expected structure. Identify changes before the next processing step.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/telecommunications/#section-2-title): Review missed activations and billing discrepancies with the relevant teams.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/telecommunications/#section-3-title): Follow one order through activation and billing. Measure unmatched references and review time. Operational changes remain in the authorised source systems.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/telecommunications/#section-4-title): Repeat the order-to-billing comparison with new records. Keep the agreed rules and execution results together so teams can review changes without rebuilding the comparison.

## Business problem walkthroughs

### [Answer a review without rebuilding the story.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/audit-ready-data-operations/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/audit-ready-data-operations/#section-1-title): Follow recorded work to the available inputs, checks, results and responsible people. Keep missing evidence visible rather than filling gaps with assumptions.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/audit-ready-data-operations/#section-2-title): Connect recorded actions, results and available evidence for operational oversight and subsequent review.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/audit-ready-data-operations/#section-3-title): Reconstruct one recorded result. Measure retrieval time and missing evidence. Technical records are not legal certification or a complete record of external activity.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/audit-ready-data-operations/#section-4-title): Keep the recorded result, its references and the review scope together. A later request can start from the same evidence instead of another search through exported files.

### [Check the move, not just the transfer status.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/controlled-data-migration/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/controlled-data-migration/#section-1-title): Agree on the comparison, transfer supported data and inspect differences between source and target before accepting the move.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/controlled-data-migration/#section-2-title): Turn data preparation, processing and transfer into repeatable workflows with checks and execution tracking.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/controlled-data-migration/#section-3-title): Agree on records, counts and comparison rules. Review differences and record acceptance. Connector support and recovery procedures must be checked for the actual move.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/controlled-data-migration/#section-4-title): Repeat the agreed mapping and comparison on the next batch or rehearsal. Review newly observed differences before accepting that execution.

### [Move data without losing sight of the result.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/data-modernization/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/data-modernization/#section-1-title): Prepare transfers, compare source and target results and review exceptions before accepting the move.
  - [Source and destination totals need reconciling.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/controlled-data-migration/): Compare source and destination using agreed keys, counts and totals. Review unmatched records as well as aggregate differences.
  - [A schema change leaves fields without a mapping.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/trusted-bi-ai-inputs/): Compare the observed structure with the transfer mapping. Identify fields that have no agreed destination.
  - [Technical completion is not business acceptance.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/audit-ready-data-operations/): Bring the comparison, exceptions and execution records into one review. Accept the checked scope, not merely the transfer status.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/data-modernization/#section-2-title): A phased transition with explicit checks, rather than a transfer assumed to be successful.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/data-modernization/#section-3-title): Compare an agreed source and target sample. Measure unmatched records and repeated checks. Accept only the tested scope; a successful transfer is not sufficient.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/data-modernization/#section-4-title): Reuse the accepted mapping and comparison rules in the next rehearsal or batch. Record new differences rather than assuming that a previous successful run proves the next one.

### [Find the answer without searching every system.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/#section-1-title): Bring permitted information together, identify its sources and separate confirmed findings from unknowns. Use the available evidence to decide what to check next.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/#section-2-title): Get a shared view of information without manually searching and combining data from several applications.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/#section-3-title): Investigate one exception using permitted records. Measure preparation time and missing information. Separate confirmed facts from causes that still need checking.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/#section-4-title): Preserve the selected records and available result references. The next reviewer can continue from established findings and unresolved questions instead of restarting the investigation.

### [Explain why a result changed.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/governed-analytics-delivery/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/governed-analytics-delivery/#section-1-title): Keep the chosen data and report versions connected to the recorded result. Compare changes and investigate differences before using the numbers.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/governed-analytics-delivery/#section-2-title): Connect the numbers to the data behind them and investigate what needs attention.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/governed-analytics-delivery/#section-3-title): Compare the data version, report definition and filters for one result. Measure time to explain the difference. Version history is not automatically a snapshot of source rows.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/governed-analytics-delivery/#section-4-title): Keep the report definition, filters and chosen data version with each recorded result. Revisit the earlier basis before interpreting a new total.

### [Check the inputs before the report goes out.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/regulatory-reporting/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/regulatory-reporting/#section-1-title): Prepare data from approved sources, apply agreed checks and link the result to the definitions used. Review exceptions before the next reporting step.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/regulatory-reporting/#section-2-title): A reviewed reporting dataset, differences linked to individual records and a selected report version that the team can explain before submission.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/regulatory-reporting/#section-3-title): Compare one reporting period. Measure corrections, repeat submissions and time to acceptance. Your specialists approve reporting definitions and obligations.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/regulatory-reporting/#section-4-title): Reuse the approved preparation and checks for the next period. Keep corrections and selected result versions distinguishable so the team can explain the submitted figures.

### [Give reports and AI a reliable starting point.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/trusted-bi-ai-inputs/)

- [How advanexus helps](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/trusted-bi-ai-inputs/#section-1-title): Prepare reusable data, check it and choose the version to share. Give people and supported tools access only to what they are allowed to use.
- [What your team gains](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/trusted-bi-ai-inputs/#section-2-title): One prepared data version with known fields and checks, reusable in permitted reports and AI tools instead of preparing separate extracts for reports and AI tools.
- [Try it with your own process](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/trusted-bi-ai-inputs/#section-3-title): Use one approved question and data version. Check allowed fields, denied access and recorded calls. Do not assume the external assistant's full conversation is captured.
- [Keep the next cycle connected.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/trusted-bi-ai-inputs/#section-4-title): Reuse the selected data version in permitted reports and AI-assisted work. When inputs change, make a new version available without silently replacing the earlier result.

## Authoritative public pages

The pages below are the authoritative public sources for current capabilities, boundaries, trust information and engagement terms.

- [Existing systems. Less manual work between them.](https://www.advanexus.com/): advanexus connects data preparation and transfer, business checks and analysis. Get a result that can be explained, reused and taken into the next step, without replacing your existing systems.
- [Critical product information should be perceivable and operable.](https://www.advanexus.com/accessibility/): Last reviewed 16 July 2026. The site is designed around semantic HTML, keyboard access, visible focus, responsive reading and reduced motion; final conformance requires testing of the exact frozen build.
- [Existing systems. A connected path from data to result.](https://www.advanexus.com/advanexus/): A report, delivery or payment can depend on several systems. advanexus brings the supported data work into one flow: prepare the inputs, check differences, create the result and keep the context needed to use it again.
- [Start with a clear purpose and the right amount of context.](https://www.advanexus.com/contact/): Based in Ljubljana, Slovenia, advanexus starts with your process and the result you need. Get in touch to discuss the platform, a demonstration or a focused pilot. Please do not send credentials, production data or sensitive records.
- [Bring one critical data flow. Start with operational reality.](https://www.advanexus.com/demo-request/): The first conversation is not a generic feature tour. It maps the systems, hand-offs, owners, permissions, quality gates, delivery obligations and evidence requirements behind one important outcome.
- [Direct answers for the person deciding whether advanexus fits.](https://www.advanexus.com/faqs/): Start with the business question. Each answer then states the product boundary so a buyer can distinguish current capability, accepted deployment scope and future direction.
- [Choose a situation you recognise](https://www.advanexus.com/platform/world/): A report, delivery or payment can depend on several systems. advanexus brings the supported data work into one flow: prepare the inputs, check differences, create the result and keep the context needed to use it again.
- [A software licence with a clear scope.](https://www.advanexus.com/pricing/): The licence includes all platform modules and Intelligence. Profiles differ in capacity, environments and product support, not in access to modules. Outside the licence: Cloud, infrastructure preparation and operation, implementation, custom development, integrator services and external provider consumption.
- [Your systems stay. The work between them comes together.](https://www.advanexus.com/product/): Bring data from databases and files into a reusable workflow: prepare it, move it, check it and use it for analysis. Keep the relevant versions and execution records with the result, so the next question does not start another search.
- [Explore deeper questions with Python in the same project.](https://www.advanexus.com/product/anpy/): Use notebooks for analysis with selected file inputs and approved packages. Keep the notebook revision, environment and execution record together so the work can be reviewed in context.
- [See what stands behind a result.](https://www.advanexus.com/product/assurance/): Start from a result, execution or recorded event. Follow its available versions and relationships, inspect supporting evidence and see what remains unverified before deciding the next step.
- [Show the numbers. Explain the result behind them.](https://www.advanexus.com/product/controlled-analytics/): Build reports and charts from an accepted dataset version. Explore dimensions and filters, then return to the saved report definition and run context when someone asks how a result was obtained.
- [Turn data from separate sources into repeatable work.](https://www.advanexus.com/product/data-operations/): Explore connected databases, prepare files and tables, and arrange supported transfers and quality checks. Keep the definition, run status and recorded outcome together when the work is repeated.
- [Find data exceptions before the next step.](https://www.advanexus.com/product/data-quality/): Define what acceptable data means, run repeatable checks and inspect recorded failures. Use supported workflow gates to stop downstream work when a required check fails.
- [Prepare a dataset once. Control how its definition changes.](https://www.advanexus.com/product/governed-datasets/): Create a reusable dataset for analysis and reporting. Compare versions of its query and columns, keep the source reference, and choose when a report adopts a changed definition.
- [Connect heterogeneous systems through explicit capability contracts.](https://www.advanexus.com/product/integrations/): A connector name is only the beginning. advanexus resolves which discovery, read, transfer, write, quality and analytics operations the exact driver and deployment can support safely.
- [Turn a business question into a useful next step.](https://www.advanexus.com/product/intelligence/): Ask about the selected data or task in your own words. Get explanations, SQL drafts and proposed next steps based on permitted context, while platform checks govern what can be executed.
- [Ask your AI assistant about approved business information.](https://www.advanexus.com/product/mcp/): Connect a supported AI assistant to selected project resources. Ask questions, run approved checks and read permitted results, with access choices and a record of each call.
- [Check one business situation across multiple systems.](https://www.advanexus.com/product/monitoring/): Run a reviewed check with an order, payment or another agreed identifier. See the combined result, which sources responded and the saved run the team can return to.

They distinguish current capability, environment dependency and planned work rather than publishing generic data-governance commentary.

- [Use Intelligence without confusing an answer with an action.](https://www.advanexus.com/resources/guides/use-intelligence-safely/): Use this workflow when natural-language assistance must remain bound to the current actor, tenant, Project, exact object, registered tools and canonical execution evidence.
- [From a clear problem to a result your organisation can accept.](https://www.advanexus.com/services/): We define the process, agree on the checks that matter, implement the supported flow and hand over a way to operate it.
- [Trust is a product behaviour, not a badge.](https://www.advanexus.com/trust/): The Trust Center explains how scope, authorisation, versions, bounded execution, integrity and evidence work—and where environment acceptance or planned hardening still matters.
- [Explicit boundaries connect the platform without collapsing responsibility.](https://www.advanexus.com/trust/architecture/): advanexus is a modular platform with separate tenant and administrative delivery surfaces, control and tenant data stores, workload queues, storage adapters and a trusted Python runtime boundary.
- [Product truth is stronger when status and boundary appear together.](https://www.advanexus.com/trust/capability-status/): Public claims use four states so delivered behaviour, production acceptance, environment dependencies and planned work are not collapsed into one marketing label.
- [Production readiness belongs to an exact build in an exact environment.](https://www.advanexus.com/trust/deployment/): Runtime diagrams and repository tests describe boundaries. Production sign-off requires recorded migration, authorisation, recovery, storage, connector, browser and operational acceptance on immutable artifacts.
- [Evidence is strongest when its source, scope and limitations remain visible.](https://www.advanexus.com/trust/evidence-model/): advanexus connects supported canonical events and module-specific evidence into a permission-aware investigation model while preserving the difference between a source record, a projection and a human workflow.
- [The model is not the security boundary.](https://www.advanexus.com/trust/responsible-ai/): advanexus Intelligence separates natural-language reasoning from deterministic authorisation and execution. A useful response never grants itself access or converts generated text into an unreviewed platform action.
- [Security decisions remain server-owned and scope-bound.](https://www.advanexus.com/trust/security-governance/): Browser visibility is not an authorisation boundary. Protected routes, application services and repository predicates re-evaluate identity, tenant, project and permission context where the operation requires it.
- [Use Cases](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/): advanexus is a platform for connecting and processing data from your systems and files. Prepare data, run business checks and build reports, with clear access rules and a record of each execution.
- [From data to work done.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/): advanexus is a platform for connecting and processing data from your systems and files. Prepare data, run business checks and build reports, with clear access rules and a record of each execution.
- [Answer a review without rebuilding the story.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/audit-ready-data-operations/): A request for evidence should not restart the search through files, systems and colleagues.
- [Check the move, not just the transfer status.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/controlled-data-migration/): A completed transfer does not tell your team whether the destination contains the expected result.
- [Move data without losing sight of the result.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/data-modernization/): Existing systems must keep serving teams while data moves to a new environment.
- [Find the answer without searching every system.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/evidence-backed-investigation/): An exception can require several people to assemble statuses, records and context before anyone can act.
- [Explain why a result changed.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/governed-analytics-delivery/): Different definitions and input versions can turn the same business question into conflicting reports.
- [Check the inputs before the report goes out.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/regulatory-reporting/): Late corrections consume time and make reported figures harder to explain.
- [Give reports and AI a reliable starting point.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/business-problems/trusted-bi-ai-inputs/): Teams repeat data preparation when definitions, versions and quality checks are unclear.
- [Find the problem your team needs to solve.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/): Choose your industry to see how advanexus connects information, simplifies checks and helps your team act on the result.
- [Bring readings and billing into agreement.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/energy/): Meter readings, billing periods and units often need checking across separate systems.
- [Know why the numbers do not match.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/financial-services/): Finance and risk teams often reconcile figures from several systems before they can trust a report.
- [See the whole claim, not separate fragments.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/insurance/): Policy, claim and payment information sits in different systems, making incomplete records difficult to spot.
- [Find what is holding up a delivery.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/logistics-supply-chain/): Transport, warehouse, document and invoice updates arrive from different teams and systems.
- [Bring departmental information into one review.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/public-sector/): Teams collect submissions and records from several departments before preparing a shared report.
- [Follow the order through to the bill.](https://www.advanexus.com/use-cases/industries/telecommunications/): Sales, activation and billing can disagree about the same service.
- [Keep the whole job connected, not just the data.](https://www.advanexus.com/why-advanexus/): Preparation, checks, analysis and follow-up often sit in separate tools. advanexus connects these steps around the same result, with its definitions, versions and available execution records. Existing systems keep their roles; teams get a reusable way to work across them.
